name: Nimba otter shrew
desc: A small nocturnal semi-aquatic insectivore living along creeks in the Nimba area. Mining runoff threatens its streams.
about: The Nimba otter shrew is a dwarf otter shrew and belongs to the mammal family Potamogalidae. Otter shrews are shrew-like afrotherian mammals found in sub-Saharan Africa.
